verses.pali: Tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi …pe…
verses.english: There Venerable Sāriputta addressed the mendicants:

verses.pali: pañcahi, āvuso, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṁsājīvo sabrahmacārīnaṁ.
verses.english: “A mendicant with five qualities is fit to share their life with their spiritual companions.

verses.pali: Idhāvuso, bhikkhu attanā ca sīlasampanno hoti, sīlasampadākathāya ca āgataṁ pañhaṁ byākattā hoti;
verses.english: A mendicant is personally accomplished in ethics, and answers questions that come up when discussing accomplishment in ethics.

verses.pali: attanā ca samādhisampanno hoti, samādhisampadākathāya ca āgataṁ pañhaṁ byākattā hoti;
attanā ca paññāsampanno hoti, paññāsampadākathāya ca āgataṁ pañhaṁ byākattā hoti;
attanā ca vimuttisampanno hoti, vimuttisampadākathāya ca āgataṁ pañhaṁ byākattā hoti;
attanā ca vimuttiñāṇadassanasampanno hoti, vimuttiñāṇadassanasampadākathāya ca āgataṁ pañhaṁ byākattā hoti.
verses.english: They’re personally accomplished in the knowledge and vision of freedom, and they answer questions that come up when discussing accomplishment in the knowledge and vision of freedom.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, āvuso, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṁsājīvo sabrahmacārīnan”ti.
verses.english: A mendicant with these five qualities is fit to share their life with their spiritual companions.”
